about_item: Tailored Power Boost: Enjoy up to 12W of optimized charging with Anker's PowerIQ and VoltageBoost technology, plus a trickle-charge mode for devices like Bluetooth earpieces and fitness bands. This portable charger ensures your devices stay powered throughout the day.

Multilayer Device Defense: Anker’s MultiProtect safety system, featured in this Anker Power Bank, shields against overcharging and short circuits while maintaining temperature control for a worry-free charge.

Rugged Longevity: The PowerCore Slim 10000's superior durability and scratch resistance means it's ready for any adventure. As a portable charger, it ensures reliability wherever you go, making it a trustworthy companion for all your excursions.

Slimline Energy Reserve: This ultra-thin 10,000mAh Anker Power Bank slips into your pocket, offering 2.25 full charges for an iPhone 12 or 1.6 for a Galaxy S20, keeping you powered on long trips. It's the ideal blend of convenience and power for maintaining your device's energy reserves while on the move.

What You Get: PowerCore Slim 10000 portable charger, Micro USB cable (to charge the power bank, USB-C cable and Lightning cable not included), welcome guide, 18-month warranty, and friendly customer service.

The charging speed receives mixed reviews - while some say it charges phones to 100%, others report it doesn't work at all. Reliability is also mixed, with some saying it gets the job done while others report it stops working after a month. Durability and value for money receive mixed feedback, with some finding it durable and worth the price, while others report it breaking within months and consider it a waste of money. Compatibility is a concern, with one customer reporting issues with the iPhone cord.

authors_reviews.title: Perfect for all-day Disneyland trip!
authors_reviews.text: This product was perfect for an all day trip to Disneyland! Disneyland has a great app, where visitors can see ride wait times, order food, and schedule rides on Genie Plus. Unfortunately, this can really drain your battery. We were at Disneyland for about 15 hours, and I charged my iPhone 13 twice, once it hit 70% battery. It charged back to 96 in about an hour, and that was with some use while it was plugged in.Other reviews mentioned that it obviously takes longer to charge from a lower percentage, so I stayed on top of it.Once evening hit, while waiting in line, I heard multiple people mentioning their batteries were about to die, and I felt even happier about my purchase!The battery is a bit heavy, but it is about the size of an iPhone, so it fit nicely in both a backpack and a small purse.I used it to charge my phone once at home a few days before Disneyland, and did not recharge the Anker before we left. It seemed like it had quite a bit of juice left.Definitely worth the purchase!Side note: I did notice a small vending machine near Pooh Corner in Critter Country that was selling charging packs for $30, so I would definitely recommend purchasing this Anker portable charger beforehand! It is cheaper and reliable!!
authors_reviews.author: Monica

authors_reviews.title: One of the best phone chargers I’ve ever purchased
authors_reviews.text: I’ve had this phone charger for well over a year and let me tell you I will continuously buy it over and over and over again! I very seldom actually charge it, but it always maintains a charge and it quickly charges my phone even when it’s almost dead. It works great - great performance in high heat as well. Just truly a rock solid phone charger. Would recommend it to anybody.
authors_reviews.author: Kristi

authors_reviews.title: It charges phones quickly, but holds its own charge a long time
authors_reviews.text: This charger has been a godsend, especially for travel. My phone often runs out of power within a day. When we attach the charger, it works as backup so I can use the phone indefinitely. In fact, the phone is usually fully charged within a few hours, even while I'm user the charger as a back up. We've used the charger for several days with various devices before needing to recharge it. The only negative is that the charger is a bit heavy. When we use it as a back up, the weight of phone+charger+cord is a lot for a small purse.
authors_reviews.author: WGTactor

authors_reviews.title: Good battery, could use some improvements
authors_reviews.text: I bought 4 of these, in black and white, when they were on sale.They provide good power, and are definitely worth the sub-$20 price.I would have preferred a few improvements, without drastically raising the price:1. Slow charging - Charging a battery from empty to full takes quite a few hours. High wattage fast chargers don’t speed up the charging. If you need to charge at least half, I recommend charging overnight.2. Can only output from USB-A port. This battery has 3 ports - USB-A, Micro USB, and USB-C. You can only charge it by plugging a cable into the Micro USB or USB-C. You can only receive a charge from the USB-A port. Most mobile phones, headphones, and earbuds today have only a USB-C charging port, and most modern wall chargers today have a USB-C port. A single USB-C to USB-C cable is enough for most charging requirements, except for this battery. This battery requires an additional cable, and it’s frustrating.
authors_reviews.author: HagayV

authors_reviews.author: Lanez Cragan

authors_reviews.title: Works really well
authors_reviews.text: This battery pack works really well. I bought it after an unexpected extended power outage due to a bad storm left me unprepared. Not only does it hold its charge well while in use, it holds its charge after months sitting there unused, making it ideal for unexpected outages. I noticed from several reviews that people think it doesn't work, and it's because they have the input/outputs mixed up. You charge your devices from this battery while using the USB port, and you charge the battery with the usb-c/usb micro input ports. I had my phone running all evening as a hot spot for my laptop and then all night long with a white noise app playing and it only lost 1/5 of its charge. I think it's worth the money.
authors_reviews.author: mia

authors_reviews.title: Slow slow slow charging
authors_reviews.text: Don't bother. Do yourself a favor and pay more for something better. I can't even return it since I ordered it to my friends house, and she brought it to me for a trip. We came from separate places, and where I'm currently at, return options are severely limited. Good amount of reviews, and it's from Anker so I trusted it but their quality lately is no longer trustworthy. If I don't touch my s22 plus, takes about 1.5 hours to charge from 50% to 100%. If I'm using it for navigation? It barely stops the battery from draining - it supplies about as much as I use.
authors_reviews.author: Lucy

authors_reviews.title: Amazed at the life of this charger
authors_reviews.text: Best portable charger I've owned. It's lightweight, charged my phone quickly, and gave me multiple charges during a single day of travel. It takes longer than most to recharge, but worth it for the power it provides. Both my husband and I had one during our last trip when it was our only power source during the day and never once was concerned about not having the power we needed for directions, pictures, videos, car service requests, etc. Only minor down side is the only power cord included is the one to charge the charger itself. You'll have to purchase a separate one to connect the charger to your phone.
authors_reviews.author: B. Amolsch

other_countries_reviews.title: Works well.
other_countries_reviews.text: I bought this portable charger for my travels.It’s slim and compact. Looks good. Quality does not feel cheap. Charges my iPhone fairly quick.Good to have while your travelling. I like it.Downside: It has two input ports for charging the actual device itself and only ONE output for charging your personal device like your iPhone/tablet/earphones etc. I personally would rather have one USB port to charge the portable charger itself and then have two output ports for charging multiple devices (ex: your iPhone and Apple Watch at the same time). But that’s my opinion and user feedback. Wireless charging would also be a cool feature to have too. Overall it’s a good compacted portable charger that gets the job done. I also don’t feel like the batter is significantly drained after charging my device(s). I used the portable charger this afternoon to briefly charge my iPhone. I’m currently charging my Apple Watch from approx. 11% to 100% and then about to charge my iPhone again (<20%) and the portable charger looks like it still has a full-charge.
